title: ROMA: Recursive Open Meta-Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and evaluating a recursive multi-agent framework (ROMA) and a prompt optimization method (GEPA+). While it utilizes a variety of benchmarks to test reasoning, writing, and safety (e.g., SEAL-0, EQ-Bench, PAPILLON), its primary focus is on architectural efficiency and task decomposition rather than the evaluation of religion, faith, or specific ethical systems.
